title: Minimum Operations to Make Numbers Non-positive
summary: Given an array nums and integers x and y, perform operations where you decrement an element by x and decrement all other elements by y.
statement: Given an array nums and integers x and y, perform operations where you decrement an element by x and decrement all other elements by y. Determine the least number of such operations needed to ensure all elements in nums are non-positive.
constraints: Each operation chooses one index to decrease by x and decreases every other index by y, where x is greater than y.
Return the minimum operations required to make every array value non-positive.
hints: After t operations, every value receives t*y baseline decrease.
A still-positive value needs ceil(remaining/(x-y)) of the t chosen-index bonuses; sum these needs and compare with t.
The allocation is feasible exactly when total required choices fits the t operations, and feasibility remains true for every larger t.
editorial: The allocation is feasible exactly when total required choices fits the t operations, and feasibility remains true for every larger t.

tests.explanation: Three operations can assign the larger decrease where needed while baseline decreases handle the rest.
One operation targeting the value two makes every value non-positive.
